executive_summary: Overall store performance is healthy, generating $32,230 in ad revenue at a 4.82× ROAS (Return On Ad Spend), well above the 3.0× target. However, the single biggest problem is underperforming spend in campaigns like Meta - Prospecting ($950 spend at 2.20× ROAS) and Google Performance Max ($1,120 spend at 3.25× ROAS). The biggest opportunity lies in fixing high-impression organic search pages stuck on page 2—such as the Black Mermaid Prom Dress (P-101) with 52,000 impressions—and boosting low click-through rates on top-ranking products like the Red Satin Evening Gown (P-102).

issues.title: Meta - Prospecting: 14% of budget with weak returns
issues.detail: It spent $950 and earned $2,090 from 19 purchases. ROAS is 2.20× against a target of 3.0×; only 1.00% of clicks convert versus 1.80% on average. Cost per purchase is $50. If it matched the non-brand average ROAS it would have earned about $1,815 more.
issues.suggested_action: Refresh the creative and narrow or rebuild audiences; pause the weakest ad sets and test one new angle at a time before spending more.

issues.title: 3 well-ranked page(s) get far fewer clicks than their position should earn
issues.detail: These pages rank in the top 8 but their click-through rate is below 60% of the benchmark for their position. The biggest gap is Red Satin Evening Gown (P-102): 31,800 impressions at position 4.3 but only 3.0% CTR (benchmark ≈ 7.6%). Closing half of the gap on all of them is worth roughly 1,354 extra clicks per 28 days.
issues.suggested_action: Rewrite the title tags and meta descriptions to lead with the product's key attribute, price/offer and a clear call to action; add product schema (price, rating, availability) for rich results; A/B test and re-check CTR in 4 weeks.

opportunities.title: Shift budget from 3 weak campaign(s) to proven performers
opportunities.detail: Campaigns with the best returns: Meta - Retargeting (8.0×), Google Search - Prom (6.0×), Meta - Sale Creative (5.5×), Meta - New Collection (5.5×). Weak campaigns: Google Performance Max, Meta - Prospecting, Google Shopping - Dresses (combined ROAS 2.91×). Moving 20% of the weak campaigns' budget (about $590) to the winners, assuming extra spend earns only 70% of their average ROAS, would add roughly $796 of revenue for the same total spend. Branded search is excluded because it mostly captures demand that already exists; retargeting can only scale as far as its audience allows.
opportunities.suggested_action: Move budget in steps of about 10–20% every week, watch ROAS and CPA after each step, and stop increasing a campaign when its ROAS falls toward the target.
